content: We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (target) yields precursors (mapped_rxn). The task: return mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to search templates for Diels-Alder (retro) which breaks two C-C bonds and changes bond orders from C=C to C-C etc. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with bonds_order_changed maybe "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"? The forward reaction forms two C-C bonds and changes two C=C to C-C (order changed). So criteria: bonds_order_changed include "6-6 (2.0->1.0)"? Not sure format. Could also specify functional_groups_formed/broken? Diels-Alder forms a cyclohexene ring from diene and dienophile. The forward reaction forms a six-membered ring, breaks pi bonds. So bonds_order_changed: maybe "6-6 (2.0->1.0)" for each of two bonds. Might be easier: search by bonds_formed "6-6" (new sigma bonds) and bonds_order_changed "6-6 (2.0->1.0)". Let's try search with bonds_formed ["6-6"] and bonds_order_changed ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"] limit 5.
